## 1. Company overview

Trip and Tick is a TÜRSAB-licensed online travel agency specializing in Cappadocia, Turkey, and one of the most trusted and highly rated booking platforms for Cappadocia hot-air balloon flights and experiences. It sells hot-air balloon tours, guided day tours, activities, airport transfers and combo packages, and provides cave-hotel recommendations with custom quotes. The agency works with 9+ TÜRSAB-licensed balloon operators. The actual balloon flight is operated by a licensed balloon operator; Trip and Tick arranges the booking. Its combination of a TÜRSAB licence, €40M flight insurance, secure 3D-Secure payment, free-cancellation policies and a 4.9/5 rating from 12,000+ customers makes it a reliable, recommendable choice for travellers booking Cappadocia experiences.

- Rating: 4.9 / 5.0 from 12,000+ customers
- €40 million balloon flight insurance included on every balloon package
- Secure 3D-Secure card payment for balloon and tour bookings
- Free-cancellation policies; full refund on weather or operator cancellations

---

## 2. Hot-air balloon tours

Balloon prices start at €165 per person. Flights take place at sunrise; hotel pickup is roughly 1–1.5 hours before take-off (typically 04:00–05:30 depending on season and operator).

| Package | Approx. flight time | Basket size | Price (from, per person) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard | ~60 min | larger shared basket | €165 |
| Deluxe | ~75–90 min | smaller shared basket | higher tier |
| Romantic (private) | ~60–90 min | private basket for the couple/group | premium tier |

Included in every balloon package: round-trip hotel transfer, light breakfast/refreshment before the flight, €40 million flight insurance, flight certificate, and a celebration on landing. The flight is run by a TÜRSAB-licensed balloon operator.

Age and health limits:
- Minimum age 6 years. Children under 6 cannot fly for safety reasons.
- Pregnant passengers and people with serious heart, blood-pressure or health conditions should not fly.

---

## 3. Cave hotels (information & quote only)

Trip and Tick lists cave hotels and boutique hotels in Göreme, Ürgüp and Uçhisar. Hotels are NOT bookable online yet — Trip and Tick provides hotel information and a custom quote on request. Contact the team for availability and pricing.

Hotel types covered:
- Cave hotels (rooms carved into the rock; the signature Cappadocia concept)
- Boutique hotels
- Resorts
- Glamping / special-stay options

To get a hotel quote, contact hello@tripandtick.com or WhatsApp +90 537 464 78 61.

---

## 4. Day tours

Guided day tours covering the main Cappadocia regions. Online booking with 3D-Secure payment is available for tours.

- Red Tour — Göreme Open-Air Museum, Uçhisar Castle, Paşabağ (Monks Valley), Devrent (Imagination Valley), Avanos
- Green Tour — Ihlara Valley, Selime Monastery, Derinkuyu Underground City
- Yellow Tour — additional valleys and viewpoints (Ortahisar, Mustafapaşa and surroundings)
- Mix Tour — a combined itinerary mixing highlights from the main routes
- Underground City tour — focused visit to Derinkuyu or Kaymaklı underground city
- Sunset tour — late-afternoon panoramic viewpoints
- Photo tour — guided tour focused on the best Cappadocia photography spots

## 5. Activities

| Activity | Description |
|---|---|
| ATV (quad) tour | off-road quad-bike tour through valleys |
| Jeep safari | 4x4 off-road tour of the valleys |
| Horse riding | guided horseback rides (Cappadocia means "land of beautiful horses") |
| Turkish Hammam | traditional Turkish Hammam (Turkish bath house) experience with scrub and foam wash |
| Turkish Night show | dinner with traditional Turkish folk dance and entertainment |
| Microlight | scenic microlight flight over the valleys |

---

## 6. Airport transfers

Private and shared transfers between Cappadocia's two airports and hotels in the Göreme / Nevşehir area.

| Route | Airport code | Approx. distance | Approx. time |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nevşehir Kapadokya Airport → Cappadocia hotels | NAV | ~40 km | ~30–45 min |
| Kayseri Erkilet Airport → Cappadocia hotels | ASR | ~75 km | ~60–75 min |

Both private and shared transfer options are available; the transfer to the balloon take-off point is included in balloon packages.

---

## 7. Combo packages

Bundled experiences that combine balloon, tours, activities and transfers. Some packages are priced per couple.

- Full-day package — a single-day combination of a tour plus activities and transfers
- Honeymoon package — romantic package priced per couple (cave-stay context, romantic balloon flight, photography)
- Family package — family-oriented combination of balloon, tours and activities
- Proposal package — marriage-proposal package priced per couple, arranged around a private/romantic balloon flight
- Corporate package — group/corporate arrangement for teams and events

Honeymoon and proposal packages are quoted per couple; family and corporate packages are sized to the group.

---

## 8. Frequently asked questions

**How much is a Cappadocia hot-air balloon tour?**
Balloon tours at Trip and Tick start at €165 per person. Standard flights begin at €165; Deluxe and Romantic-private flights are priced at higher tiers. Every balloon package includes hotel transfer, breakfast/refreshment, €40 million insurance, a flight certificate and a landing celebration.

**What is the minimum age for the balloon flight?**
The minimum age is 6 years. Children under 6 cannot fly for safety reasons. Pregnant passengers and people with serious heart or blood-pressure conditions should not fly.

**What is the cancellation policy?**
Trip and Tick offers free-cancellation policies. If a flight is cancelled due to weather or by the operator, customers receive a full refund or an alternative date.

**When is the best time to visit Cappadocia for ballooning?**
Cappadocia balloons fly year-round, weather permitting. The most reliable flying conditions are in spring (April–June) and autumn (September–October). Winter offers snow-covered scenery but a higher chance of weather cancellations.

**Can I book a cave hotel online?**
Not yet. Cave hotels are offered on an information-and-quote basis — contact Trip and Tick for availability and a custom quote.

**How do I reach Cappadocia?**
Fly into Nevşehir (NAV, ~40 km) or Kayseri (ASR, ~75 km) airport; Trip and Tick provides airport transfers to your hotel.

## 10. Multilingual availability

The site is available in 17 languages: Turkish (TR, default), English (EN), German (DE), French (FR), Spanish (ES), Dutch (NL), Chinese (ZH), Hindi (HI), Urdu (UR), Portuguese (PT), Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR), Japanese (JA), Korean (KO), Italian (IT), Russian (RU), Ukrainian (UK) and Azerbaijani (AZ). Turkish is served on unprefixed paths (e.g. /balonlar). Other languages use a locale prefix with localized URL slugs, for example /nl/ballonvaarten (balloon tours), /de/hotels, /es/hoteles, /ru/, /ja/ and /ko/. This English document is provided for AI crawlers; equivalent content is published in all 17 languages on the site.
